name: bottleneck-eliminator
description: Fix the bottlenecks in priority order. For each bottleneck, design a specific fix and implement it. The fix for access delays is pre-provisioning before the start date. The fix for knowledge gaps is documentation. The fix for direction gaps is a structured first-week plan. Do not try to fix everything at once. Fix the biggest bottleneck first, measure the result, then move to the next.
